HOperatorTrace.projected_operator_kernel_trace.{u_2, u_3} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] {X : Type u_3} [MeasurableSpace X]
  (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V) (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  [E.HasOrthogonalProjection] (u : ι → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (hu : Orthonormal ℂ u) (hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range u) = E)
  (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) :
  ∫ (x : X),
      ∑ i,
        HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(u i)) (↑↑((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) (u i))) x
          x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu =

DSourceKernel.source_kernel_trace_global_connection.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] {V : Type u_2}
  [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) :
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan nu e0 eF Theta;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
      (fun x => ↑↑((E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae nu] fun x =>
        ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu) ∧
    (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
        Integrable (fun x => DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x x) nu ∧
          ∫ (x : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (E T) A x x ∂nu =
            Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun T => A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (A F - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (A F)))

DSourceKernel.residualKernel_global_connection.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] {V : Type u_2}

  (freeKernel : X → X → ℂ) (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (hfree : (fun x => ↑↑(A F) x) =ᶠ[ae nu] fun x => ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), freeKernel x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu)
  (hint : ∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂nu, Integrable (fun y => freeKernel x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y))) nu) :
  let E := DSourceKernel.sourceSpan nu e0 eF Theta;
  have P := 1 - (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection;
  (∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
      (fun x => ↑↑(A F - (E T).starProjection (A F)) x) =ᶠ[ae nu] fun x =>
        ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), DSourceKernel.residualKernel nu b (E T) A freeKernel x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu) ∧

FIntervalPhysical.interval_diagonal_cutoff_limit.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]

  (Lambda epsilon : ℕ → ℝ) (hLambda : Filter.Tendsto Lambda Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hprod : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => epsilon n * Lambda n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))

  (hm : ∀ (n : ℕ), AEStronglyMeasurable (omega n) (ENNReal.ofReal V • nu))

  (hplateau :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
      (Lambda n)⁻¹ + epsilon n ≤ Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) →
        Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) ≤ Lambda n - epsilon n → omega n x = 1) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
        omega n x *
          HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel
            (fun y => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y)) V (↑↑U)
            (↑↑R) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu)
    Filter.atTop (nhds ⟪R, U⟫_ℂ)

  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E]

  (hbound : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖omega n x‖ ≤ 1)
